intro: The Archaic Rune is an introductory quest given to fledgling dwarf Shamans in Dun Morogh. Imbued with elemental power from ancient Wildhammer inscriptions, this sacred tablet introduces young initiates to their elemental heritage. Delivering the stone to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar marks the formal beginning of their training in the ways of earth, air, fire, and water.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the adventurer trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of an adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new adventurers learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
